searchText: I made a mistake by running the ansible playbook against the wrong target, I cleared up a bunch of devnet-9 nodes instead of verkle testnet nodes😅 I've started the cleaned up nodes again, hopefully that doesn't disrupt anyone's debugging setup! Apologies for the mistake! small wins i guess? after the nodes started back up, the teku-geth node failed to produce a block even though it was sycned. Seems to be a enginev3 error? Node seems to keep up with head and continue afterwards
